item.title: GTA 6 Is Already Breaking Twitch Records
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: GTA 6 breaks Twitch viewership records with 3.29 million viewers and attracts nearly 7.9 million across streaming platforms.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 is already rewriting streaming history. Rockstar Games' highly anticipated sequel has attracted 3.29 million concurrent viewers on Twitch, breaking the platform's previous record for a video game launch as its global rollout continues.

item.title: GTA 6 Won’t Be Getting a Future Performance Mode, Even on PS5 Pro
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: GTA 6 will be locked at 30 FPS on current consoles and won't get a future performance mode, even on PS5 Pro.
item.content:encoded: In a rough turn of events for frame rate diehards, it seems Grand Theft Auto 6 won’t get a patch that boosts its frame rate at the expense of graphical fidelity. Speaking with Kotaku, Rockstar confirmed the game will not receive a performance mode on modern consoles, even on the beefier PlayStation 5 Pro.

item.title: GTA 6's Hidden Drug System Is Surprisingly Deep
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: GTA 6's NPCs quietly do much more around Leonida than the player can see, Rockstar revealed
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6might be known as a crime simulator, but Rockstar's open-world game is truly a sandbox full of systems. Some of these features, like the game's vast NPC generation system, are immediately apparent when you play. Others, like GTA 6's drug system, are borderline invisible — they're never mentioned in the game, and may be impossible to track.

item.title: New Friday the 13th Movie Reveals All-New Jason, Dutton Ranch Star for Cast
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: New Friday the 13th movie reveals release date and cast, including Jason and the film’s final girl, Dutton Ranch star Natalie Alyn Lind.
item.content:encoded: Just last week, Horror, Inc. announced that Jason Voorhees would be returning in a new Friday the 13th movie. The initial announcement for the lucky 13th entry in the franchise revealed that series veteran Steve Miner would be returning to direct the horror feature. Now we have a lot more details about what to expect when Jason returns next year, with the release date and cast details finally revealed.

item.title: Resident Evil's Pedestrian monster wasn't actually a practical effect
item.dc:creator: Jake Kleinman
item.description: Despite reports otherwise, the viral motion test for Resident Evil's Pedestrian didn't make it into the movie, says Weta VFX Supervisor Kevin Smith. But the effect was convincing!
item.content:encoded: Despite reports otherwise, the viral motion test for Resident Evil's Pedestrian didn't make it into the movie, says Weta VFX Supervisor Kevin Smith. But the effect was convincing!

item.title: As GTA 6 Breaks Records, Rockstar Devs Call for Union Recognition
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 developers are making a plea for unionization ahead of the game’s release.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 will almost certainly set sales records when it launches tomorrow, Nov. 19. However, despite the windfall for Rockstar Games, many of the studio’s employees remain worried about their jobs. In an opinion piece from The Guardian, Rockstar animation programmer Nestor Uriarte outlined the benefits of unionization as developers at the studio await the results of an ongoing union vote. 1,600 staff in the U.K. have until Nov. 26 to cast their ballots.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Have Already Discovered the Most Evil Crime in the Game
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: Just like in Red Dead Redemption 2, it seems like there are plenty of ways for a sincere oopsie in GTA 6 to spiral out of control fast.
item.content:encoded: The long-awaited Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't technically come out until midnight local time on Nov. 19, but plenty of eager gamers are taking advantage of the New Zealand trick to play the game early. Even though GTA 6 reviews only dropped a few hours ago, players are already getting up to plenty of hijinks in Leonida. Just like in Red Dead Redemption 2, it seems like there are plenty of ways for a sincere oopsie or button fumble to spiral out of control pretty fast.

item.title: Magic: the Gathering Is Officially Reprinting an Iconic $42 Artifact with Perfect Dune Art
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: The Dune Secret Lair Superdrop features nine new cards and valuable reprints. Here's a look at every card.
item.content:encoded: That scary box that the Bene Gesserit forced Paul Atreides to put his hand into is about to make your Magic: The Gathering artifacts a lot harder to destroy. Pain Box appears in Magic's new Dune-themed Secret Lair as a new reprint of Darksteel Forge, a powerful $42 card that gives all of your artifacts indestructible. That makes it one of the biggest draws of the "My Arrakis, My Superdrop" Secret Lair revealed Nov. 18, but the Superdrop is also chock-full of unique legendary creatures vying for a spot as your favorite new Commander.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering’s 10 Best Uncommon Star Trek Cards, Ranked
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: The most underrated uncommon cards from Magic's Star Trek set that deserve a place in your collection.
item.content:encoded: Magic: The Gathering has never been shy about crossing over with other beloved franchises, and its latest Universes Beyond set takes players into the final frontier. The Star Trek set pulls together characters, spacecraft, alien civilizations, and iconic moments from across the franchise's decades-long history, translating them into Magic’s mechanics. It's an ambitious crossover that gives longtime Trekkies plenty to get excited about, even if UB sets haven't always been embraced by Magic's more traditional player base.

item.title: GTA 6's Release Will Stress The Internet Just As Everything's Falling Apart
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: GTA 6 is releasing within days of major outages for Apple, Microsoft, and Chase Bank
item.content:encoded: In early November, some internet service providers warned their customers that pre-downloads of Grand Theft Auto 6 were causing network slowdown issues for everyone on the service. That problem became visible before millions of gamers tried to log into the same game simultaneously. A long list of recent outages and issues across industries reliant on tech and network services now makes it seem likely that the biggest game launch of all time won't go down smoothly.

item.title: 5 Big Takeaways From the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: From GTA 6 to Control and Crimson Desert, these are the conclusions for the GOTY Race and TGA 2026
item.content:encoded: Despite the dramatic timing — before Grand Theft Auto 6's release, even before reviews for Rockstar's game have been published — nominations for The Game Awards 2026 weren't very surprising. This was always going to be GTA 6's year.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem’s Game Awards Nominee Is Ready for Resident Evil 10
item.dc:creator: Matt Patches
item.description: Resident Evil Requiem was nominated for a number of TGA awards, including for Angela Sant'Albano. The actor thinks Grace could be in a sequel.
item.content:encoded: Angela Sant'Albano had never performed in a video game before Resident Evil Requiem. She'd never done motion capture, either. But after spending months physically throwing herself into the horror of Grace Ashcroft's story, she came away convinced that the medium was a perfect fit.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Boss Reveals the Next Marvel Set’s Surprising Origin Story
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: Aaron Forsythe said Magic’s original narrative got ‘total buy-in’ from Marvel
item.content:encoded: Magic: The Gatheringhas already released two Universes Beyond sets based on Marvel Comics, with Marvel’s Spider-Man in 2025 and Marvel Super Heroes in 2026. The game’s designers are taking a very different approach to their third tie-in set, Darkhold Destiny, which will launch in 2027. Rather than simply making cards based on iconic characters and comic book arcs, Wizards of the Coast designers worked with Marvel to create an entirely new storyline designed with the game’s mechanics in mind. Magic’s vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon at MagicCon Atlanta that the inspiration for the new approach came from an unlikely source.

item.title: GTA 6's Game Awards Nominations Are Exactly What Everyone Predicted
item.dc:creator: Ari Notis
item.description: GTA 6 earned eight nomination at the 2026 Game Awards — the most of any nominated game, in pretty much every category it could've.
item.content:encoded: Going into Tuesday’s reveal of the 2026 Game Awards nominees, the question wasn’t whether or not Grand Theft Auto 6 would pick up any nominations. It was more about how many nominations it would get. And now that the dust has cleared, GTA 6’s Game Awards nominations rolled out pretty much…exactly as expected.

item.title: Dune Magic: The Gathering Crossover Officially Confirmed After Major Leak
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Dune is coming to Magic: The Gathering with a new Secret Lair superdrop featuring new legendary creatures and reprints.
item.content:encoded: The spice must flow, and so must the Secret Lair drops. After several days of leaks circulating online, Dune is officially crossing over with Magic: The Gathering, with Wizards of the Coast teasing the collaboration through the official MTG Secret Lair account.

item.title: 8 Biggest Snubs in the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: The 2026 Game Awards snubbed several major games from several key categories. Here are the biggest Game Awards nominee snubs.
item.content:encoded: The Game Awards has announced its official list of nominees for this year’s prizes. Among the nominees are plenty of obvious contenders, such as Grand Theft Auto 6, Resident Evil Requiem, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. There was stiff competition across several categories, meaning that some worthy games — and Polygon favorites — didn’t make the shortlist for certain prizes. These are the biggest TGA nomination snubs of 2026.

item.title: The Mighty Nein Season 2 Officially Has Fans Worried About One Major Plot Change
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: The Mighty Nein season 2 won’t hit our screens until March, but fans are already speculating about potential changes.
item.content:encoded: The Mighty Neinseason 2 is officially set to return to our TV screens in March 2027. And while Critical Role fans may be a little put out by Amazon's new episode schedule, the season’s content has Critters excited for what’s to come from our band of lovable misfits.

item.title: Pokémon Go’s Most Cursed Crossover Officially Revealed
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Pokémon is doing a crossover with a certain language learning app.
item.content:encoded: Pokémon Go has had its share of crossovers with other brands over the past decade, including The North Face x Gucci, Major League Baseball, and Lego. The mobile gotta-catch-'em-all game's latest will bring a new critter to the game, one known to strike fear in the hearts of mobile users.

item.title: GTA 6's Rumored Lucia Actor Confirmed for Cast by Game Awards Nomination
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: The Game Awards 2026 nominees are now out. Rumored Lucia actor Manni L. Perez received a nomination for Best Performance, all-but confirming her role.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 received several nominations at The Game Awards, which were revealed on Tuesday. While GTA 6's nomination for Game of the Year wasn't too surprising, another nomination immediately stood out.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Becomes Clear Game Awards 2026 Frontrunner
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: GTA 6 leads in nominations at this year's The Game Awards, making it the obvious pick to win Game of the Year.
item.content:encoded: The Game Awards revealed its full list of nominees today, and things went as many expected: Grand Theft Auto 6 is the clear frontrunner in the 2026 Game of the Year race. GTA 6scored an impressive eight nominations, including Best Narrative, Best Action/Adventure Game, Best Game Direction, and Game of the Year. Control: Resonantis tied for second with six nominations, earning nods for Game of the Year, Best Narrative, and Best Game Direction. Resident Evil Requiem also has six nominations, including for Game of the Year.

item.title: The Game Awards Announces Game of the Year 2026 Nominees
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Game of the Year nominations have been announced for The Game Awards 2026 by host Geoff Keighley.
item.content:encoded: After months of anticipation and constant speculation, we finally know what games will duke it out for the top prize at The Game Awards 2026. Organizers for the biggest night in gaming announced this year's nominees for Game of the Year, and all the other categories, during a livestream on Tuesday, Nov. 17.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals a ‘Mind-Blowing’ Detail About Netflix’s New Series
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: Netflix and Wizards are working together to get the look of each plane right
item.content:encoded: Netflix first announced it was working on a Magic: The GatheringTV series in 2019, and the project has been trapped in development hell ever since, passed between three different creative teams. Now Planeswalker is finally set to debut in 2027, and Wizards of the Coast shared a first look during a preview panel at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026. While the trailer introduced the young pyromancer Chandra Nalaar and her mentor Ajani Goldmane, Magic: The Gathering vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon in an interview at MagicCon that this won’t be a typical hero’s journey story.

item.title: Critical Role's Newest Campaign Officially Gets a Release Date and Cast Announcement
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: Critical Role's new campaign, 'Reign of the Weredragon,' will feature familiar faces and tips and tricks from Darrington Press's Chris Perkins.
item.content:encoded: Critters are in for a treat in 2027, with Critical Role’s brand-new Daggerheart miniseries, Reign of the Weredragon, premiering on Wednesday, Jan. 13 at 3 p.m. PT.

item.content:encoded: What is great "game direction"? We love asking those in charge because everyone's answer is different.

item.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Officially Getting the Feature Every Racing Game Needs
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: Fuse Games' Star Wars Galactic Racer is getting local split-screen multiplayer after the new year, a featured fans have long requested.
item.content:encoded: Scrib doon! Star Wars: Galactic Racer developer Fuse Games announced the racing sim is getting a key ingredient next year: split-screen multiplayer. Up to four players will be able to square off on the same screen at once after the update.

item.title: What Makes The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time So Great Anyway?
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: Zelda: Ocarina of Time always gets called one of the best games ever, and it deserves that title for reasons beyond simple nostalgia
item.content:encoded: Spend even a little time online in gaming circles, and you'll inevitably come across claims that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is one of the greatest games ever made. Those claims resurfaced with greater frequency with the announcement of the Nintendo Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake and subsequent warm reception from critics. The reaction from those I know who played for the first time and enjoyed it has generally been "yes, it really is one of the greats." What there's been less of, however, is a concerted effort to explain what exactly makes it deserving of that praise. Make no mistake, it does deserve it — and not just for reasons of nostalgia. That’s because Ocarina of Time anticipated some of gaming's biggest trends, and now that those trends have spiralled out of control, the remake serves as a blueprint for good game design moving forward.

item.title: Marvel’s Newest Superhero Was Created to Solve a Major Magic: The Gathering Problem
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: Magic: The Gathering designer Aaron Forsythe explains why Marvel’s new hero was created to fix an ongoing problem with Universes Beyond.
item.content:encoded: In an interview with Polygon at MagicCon: Atlanta, Magic vice president of design Aaron Forsythe talked about the unique approach that Marvel and Wizards of the Coast are taking for the game’s third crossover set, specifically about the development of a unique character that will feature prominently in Darkhold Destiny and the accompanying Marvel Comics.

item.title: Nintendo Fans Blast New Switch 2 Release as ‘Paid Downgrade’
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.category: Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
item.description: Pikmin 4 fans are not impressed with the game’s Switch 2 upgrade, Dandori Academy.
item.content:encoded: So far, the Nintendo Switch 2 upgraded editions of games originally released on the Switch have been a bit of a mixed bag. While games like Kirby and the Forgotten Landreceived significant new content and noticeable performance upgrades, others such as Xenoblade Chronicles X weren’t quite as well received. According to many Pikmin fans, the recently released Switch 2 version of Pikmin 4 falls into the latter camp.

item.title: Obsession Director Officially Casts Horror Icon in Next Film
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: Obsession director Curry Barker has cast horror icon and Scream star Matthew Lillard in his next film, Anything but Ghosts.
item.content:encoded: Curry Barker's Obsession is one of the year's best horror films, but his next movie might end up being even better. Barker is writing, directing, and starring in next year's Anything but Ghosts, and he'll be joined by a horror movie icon.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Turns a Fan-Favorite Star Trek Character Into a Commander Staple
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: Jadzia Dax, Living Legacy is one of the Universes Beyond set’s best cards
item.content:encoded: Like many Magic: The Gathering Universes Beyond sets, the Star Trek crossover feels built for Commander. Not only does it include four preconstructed Commander decks, but it’s packed with legendary creatures and spacecraft that can serve as your Commander or neatly slot into the deck’s other 99 cards. One of the most versatile cards in the set works in several Commander archetypes but could also easily fit in Limited and competitive constructed decks. It pays tribute to one of the best Star Trek characters, while borrowing mechanics from a very different Universes Beyond set.

item.title: Amazon Officially Reveals Early Black Friday Gaming Deals
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: Cyberpunk 2077, Split Fiction, and even some GOTY contenders on Nintendo, PlayStation, and Xbox are all discounted on Amazon for Black Friday 2026.
item.content:encoded: Your calendar might mark Nov. 27 as Black Friday, but the reality is that retailers treat the entire month like a discount event. Sales for major gaming products are staggered throughout the month, as evidenced by Amazon's self-described early Black Friday deals. The online retailer has earmarked a wide range of games for every taste in these deals, from recent action titles to critical darlings and everything in between.

item.title: The 2026 Game Awards Nominations Will Spoil GTA 6 Reviews
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6's late entry into the GOTY race is awkwardly timed for both Rockstar Games and TGA's jury
item.content:encoded: GTA 6 will be released at midnight, local to whatever region you're in, on Thursday, Nov. 19. Nominations for The Game Awards will be announced at 12 p.m. EST on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The timing of the review embargo for GTA 6 is a secret closely guarded by Rockstar's famously tight NDAs, but luckily we have plenty of clear precedent to go on.

item.title: GTA 6's Official First Updates Are Great News For Fans
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: Even GTA 6 fans who already preloaded the game have two updates to download on PS5 and Xbox
item.content:encoded: Hopefully you've still got room on your hard drive after preloading the heftyGrand Theft Auto 6 in anticipation of its impending release day. You've got at least one more thing you need to download if you want to enjoy Rockstar's open-world game the moment it goes live on Nov. 19, though. Here's what you need to know about when you can download the GTA 6 update — and what's reportedly inside.

item.title: Halo Defined a Generation of LAN Parties — Then It Killed Them
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: As Xbox and Halo turn 25, a look back at the chaotic LAN parties that made multiplayer unforgettable — and how Halo 2 helped make gathering optional.
item.content:encoded: So old, in fact, that the upcoming 25th anniversary of the Xbox and Halo: Combat Evolved immediately made me think about the LAN parties my brother and I used to host in middle and high school. There were a dozen or so teenage boys, four TVs, and enough Ethernet cable to turn my parents’ house into a tripping hazard that could also burst into flames at any moment. I’ve played countless multiplayer games since, but none have come close to the majesty of those experiences.

item.title: Extremely Rare Pokémon Game Found 20 Years Later
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: PSA Video Games confirms that a collector has unearthed a playable copy of PokéPark Fishing Rally DS, a previously lost piece of Pokémon history.
item.content:encoded: PokéPark Fishing Rally DS was a 2005 temporary fishing game obtainable through Download Play on the Nintendo DS. To play it, gamers had to get it from Download Play stations at PokéPark in Nagoya, Japan. The game would remain on their console for 12 hours or until the console was shut off. After this, it would delete itself.

item.title: 10 Most Underrated RPGs of the Past Decade
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: Some stellar RPGs have arrived over the last decade, but their brilliance made 10 absolute gems easy to miss.
item.content:encoded: There’s something about RPGs. These games tell amazing stories players want to experience time and time again, are populated by memorable characters, and often explore deep themes — even if their heroes do tend to have memory problems, spiky hair, and swords the size of New Jersey.

item.title: Prime Video's Near-Perfect Game of Thrones Replacement Officially Arrives in 2 Months
item.dc:creator: Jake Kleinman
item.description: Time to start sharpening your bloodaxe...
item.content:encoded: A weak king rules over a cobbled-together kingdom that's already coming apart at the seams. Various heroes and villains compete and scheme to claim the throne. A new challenger rises up from across the sea, full of vengeance and bloodlust... If that sounds like the premise of Game of Thrones, well, that's because it is, but it's also the set-up for Prime Video's thrilling new action drama from one of the 21st-century's most successful (and underappreciated) showrunners.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s No. 1 cause of death officially revealed
item.dc:creator: Ashley Potter
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: The most modern thing about the Zelda remake might just be its mobile app.
item.content:encoded: The Zelda: Ocarina of Timeremake has officially been out for more than two weeks, and saying its reception has been good would be an understatement. It was named the No. 2 best-selling game on the Nintendo Switch 2, with over 5.2 million copies reportedly sold less than four days after launch. Longtime Zelda fans and newcomers alike have been enjoying revisiting the 1998 classic in this remake.

item.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Is Finally Getting Capcom’s Fastest-Selling Game Ever
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: Monster Hunter Wilds is coming to Switch 2, just in time for the holiday season. And it's also a cool 25% off ahead of launch.
item.content:encoded: With the success of Resident Evil Requiem, Pragmata, and Onimusha: Way of the Sword, it's safe to say that Capcom has had a fantastic 2026. And the venerable developer's 2025 wasn't too shabby either. Last February, it released Monster Hunter Wilds for PlayStation 5, Windows PC, and Xbox Series X. It went on to sell a whopping eight million copies in just three days, making it the company's fastest-selling game of all time. As of September 2026, Monster Hunter Wilds has sold 12.2 million copies, making it Capcom's 11th-best-selling game of all time. That number is set to go up significantly after Dec. 4, when it finallylaunches for Nintendo Switch 2.

item.title: GTA 6 Trophy Count and Full Completion Time Leaks in New Reports
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: Thanks to animal studies and RNG-based achievements, completionists will have to spend hundreds of hours in Grand Theft Auto 6 to 100% the game.
item.content:encoded: Millions of players will start their adventure in Leonida with the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 later this week. They're currently preparing themselves and completing the games they've left unfinished so they can dedicate all of their time to GTA 6 soon — especially gamers who have asked for time off from work to play it. But the question on many players' minds is how much time they will need to finish the story and 100% complete it.

item.title: 8 Must-Play Open-World RPGs for People With Real-Life Schedules
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Corgan
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
item.description: Busy schedule with no time to game? These eight open-world RPGs fit into short sessions, one quest or shrine at a time.
item.content:encoded: Raise your hand if this has ever happened to you: A friend texts you a screenshot of a map with 400 icons on it and the message “you’re going to love this game.” You’re excited — the map is detailed, the game looks great, and you do love it…for about 10 seconds. Until you check your calendar and remember that you’ve got a dentist appointment, three work deadlines, and a birthday dinner to prepare for, so that map is going to have to stay unexplored for a minute. (My hand is raised.)

item.title: The 2026 GOTY Race Could Be a Disaster for Indie Games
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: Big Walk's AI controversy might result in a step back after gains made at The Game Awards by Clair Obscur and Silksong
item.content:encoded: Some quibble with the definition of Clair Obscur, a sizable production, as an indie game. (For what it's worth, the studio that made it is independent, and its publisher Kepler Interactive was founded by a collective of indie studios; it's definitely culturally indie.) But even if you excluded it, this was still the first time more than one game had crossed over between the indie and GOTY categories in the history of the awards.

item.title: Super Meat Boy Is Officially Getting Remade Without Edmund McMillen's Involvement
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: The announcement of Super Meat Boy Again+ served as a reminder that Edmund McMillen is no longer part of Team Meat
item.content:encoded: Team Meat announced Super Meat Boy Again+, a remake of the classic indie platformer, during a Sweet 16 Birthday VIP Event on Nov. 14. While the announcement was meant to be celebratory, it has reminded people of the falling out that Super Meat Boy and Mewgenics creator Edmund McMillen has had with Team Meat, as he is not involved in the new project.

item.title: PlayStation Announces New Black Friday Deals On Hardware
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: The PlayStation VR2 is discounted, but the PlayStation 5 is not
item.content:encoded: Black Friday is fast approaching, so companies like Sony are already teasing the deals people can look forward to later this month. While PlayStation previously highlighted some of the games that will be discounted, it has now shared its official Black Friday hardware deals for the DualSense controller, PlayStation VR2, and more.

item.title: Stardew Valley Meets Night in the Woods in One of 2026's Scariest New Games
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.description: Village in the Shade is a horror farm sim that digs deep into the horrors of community life
item.content:encoded: I thought I knew what to expect from Village in the Shade after attending NIS America's pre-launch preview event in September. The villagers would be quirky but likeable, and things would probably get at least a little twisted, though nothing too terrible. Nippon Ichi Software's non-Disgaea games get pretty dark, as do the Labyrinth games and Yomawari. But they're dark on a small-scale, personal level, and rarely do they have something poignant to say. Village in the Shade tossed all my expectations out the window within the first few hours and, since then, has quickly rocketed up my list of the year's best games.
